about: STRACON Group Holding Inc. operates as an infrastructure and mining services company. It operates through Engineering & Technology, Infrastructure, Industrial Services, and Fleet Solutions. The company provides development, construction, and operational services to the mining and resources industry. It also offers integrated industrial solutions. In addition, it offers multidisciplinary services; and fleet solutions, such as lifting and hoisting, mobile equipment, maintenance services, and logistics and on-site support. Further, the company develops, constructs and operates mining infrastructure assets; and industrial services. STRACON Group Holding Inc. was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada. STRACON Group Holding Inc. is a subsidiary of America Infrastructure Partners S.A.S.
